name: Why is proper bathroom ventilation important?

mainEntity.name: Why is proper bathroom ventilation important?

acceptedAnswer.text: Proper bathroom ventilation is crucial for maintaining indoor air quality and preventing damage to your home. It removes excess moisture, odors, and airborne pollutants, significantly reducing the risk of mold and mildew growth. This protects structural elements, paint, and finishes from moisture-related deterioration, extending the lifespan of your bathroom materials and improving the overall health of your living environment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Proper ventilation removes moisture and odors, preventing mold growth and protecting your bathroom from damage.
